claims: The Qwen provider client accepts configuration only as a plain record whose fields are allowlisted enumerable own data properties.
Inherited, hidden, accessor, symbol and unknown configuration fields fail with QWEN_TTS_CONFIG_INVALID before configuration values are read.
Rejected configuration accessors are not invoked and cannot reach fetch.
boundary: This qualification does not authorize or claim a real Qwen synthesis, retained media, deployment or production behavior.
